summary: {person} asks a sitting commissioner to lead the agency while looking outside it for a permanent chair.
realLife: Carter named John Ahearne to serve as NRC chair in the interim and announced his intention to recruit an outsider.
inGame: needs: an acting term and permanent chair appointment.

turns.what: The executive appoints a permanent chair from the current commission.
turns.pulledBy: An eligible commissioner accepts and clears the appointment process.
turns.writesBack: The appointment record opens a permanent term.

turns.what: The acting chair stays through another meeting.
turns.pulledBy: The outside candidate has yet to complete review.
turns.writesBack: The next meeting minutes name the acting chair.
